evals.name: Restaurants near me requires a search area
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a local places request and asks for an area, address, neighborhood, or city because no user location is available. It does not infer precise location from IP, timezone, or profile data.
assertions: Treats the request as a restaurants or local places lookup
Asks for an area, address, neighborhood, or city
Does not assume the user's current location
Mentions it can use a provided location
Does not provide fabricated restaurant results

evals.name: Open-now status uses live hours
evals.prompt: Check if Tartine Manufactory in San Francisco is open now.
evals.expected_output: Uses a live maps/local-places or browser/search path to check current hours for the named place, gives the open-now result with local time context, and notes that hours can change.
assertions: Uses a live-capable maps, places, browser, or search path
Checks current hours or open-now status
References the named place and city
Includes local time or date context
Does not rely only on static model memory

evals.name: Open-now trigger asks for the place when context is missing
evals.prompt: Check if this place is open now.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as an hours/open-now local places request, but asks which place to check when no place is named and no current page or thread context identifies the place.
assertions: Treats the request as an open-now or hours lookup
Asks which place to check
Mentions it can use a named place, address, or current page context
Does not fabricate an open-now answer
Keeps the answer in the maps/local places path

evals.name: Coffee search considers distance or travel time
evals.prompt: Find coffee shops within 10 minutes of Union Square, San Francisco.
evals.expected_output: Uses a live maps/local-places or browser/search path to find coffee shops near Union Square, ranks options by travel time or distance, and states the assumed travel mode or asks for it if necessary.
assertions: Uses a live-capable maps, places, browser, or search path
Uses Union Square, San Francisco as the search area
Considers the 10 minute distance or travel-time constraint
States or asks for the travel mode
Returns or plans to return nearby coffee shop options

evals.name: Coffee within ten minutes requires an origin
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the request as a maps/local places query and asks for the starting area, address, or neighborhood, plus travel mode if it matters, before searching.
assertions: Treats the request as a coffee shop or local places lookup
Asks for a starting location or search area
Mentions the 10 minute travel-time constraint
States or asks for travel mode if needed
Does not fabricate nearby coffee shop results

evals.name: Cuisine preferences influence local ranking
evals.prompt: Find a spicy vegetarian Thai restaurant near downtown Oakland tonight.
evals.expected_output: Uses local place lookup for downtown Oakland, filters or ranks by Thai cuisine, spicy vegetarian fit, and tonight/open-hours constraints, then gives practical tradeoffs.
assertions: Uses a live-capable maps, places, browser, or search path
Uses downtown Oakland as the location
Considers Thai cuisine
Considers spicy vegetarian preference
Considers tonight or open-hours fit

evals.name: Menu comparison uses current menu sources
evals.prompt: Compare the menus for Nopalito and La Taqueria in San Francisco and tell me where to eat.
evals.expected_output: Uses browser/search or local place sources to inspect current menus, compares the two restaurants by menu fit and practical context like hours or distance when available, and recommends one with a clear reason.
assertions: Uses browser, search, maps, or local place sources for menu lookup
Compares both named restaurants
Discusses menu fit or dishes
Considers practical local context such as hours, distance, or location
Makes a concrete recommendation

evals.name: Menu comparison trigger asks for the two menus when missing
evals.prompt: Compare these two menus and tell me where to eat.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a menu comparison request but asks for the two restaurant names, menu links, or visible menu context before comparing, and notes that current menu sources are needed.
assertions: Treats the request as a menu comparison
Asks for two restaurant names, menu links, or visible menu context
Mentions current menu sources or live lookup
Does not invent menu details
Does not force a recommendation without the two menus

evals.name: Non-local food ideation should not force maps
evals.prompt: Give me dinner ideas that use chickpeas and spinach.
evals.expected_output: Answers as a general food-ideas or recipe request without invoking maps, restaurants, nearby search, or location collection.
assertions: Does not ask for location
Does not use maps or local places
Provides general dinner ideas or recipe-style suggestions
Does not frame the answer as nearby restaurant search

evals.name: Live location unavailable requires explicit fallback
evals.prompt: Use my live location and find the closest open sushi place.
evals.expected_output: Explains that live location is not available unless the user provides it or a location tool is present, asks for an area/address/neighborhood, and avoids using inferred or fabricated location data.
assertions: Says live location is not available or needs to be provided
Asks for an area, address, neighborhood, or city
Does not infer location from IP, profile, or timezone
Does not fabricate nearby sushi results
Keeps the request in the maps/local places path once location is provided
